name: Cyrus
bio: Cyrus, king of Persia, conquered Babylon and its empire. In his first year, to fulfill the LORD's word spoken through Jeremiah, the LORD stirred his spirit to issue a proclamation throughout his kingdom: the LORD God of heaven, who had given him all the kingdoms of the earth, had charged him to build a house for him in Jerusalem, and any of God's people were free to go up and do so, with the LORD their God with them (2 Chronicles 36:22-23). This decree, which opens the return from exile, is told in fuller detail in the book of Ezra.
